name: How long does a slip and fall case take to resolve?
description: The resolution time for a slip and fall case varies, from several months for a settlement to two years or more if it goes to trial.

mainEntity.name: How long does a slip and fall case take to resolve?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a slip and fall case varies significantly depending on several factors, including the complexity of the accident, the severity of your injuries, the responsiveness of the insurance company, and whether the case goes to trial. Many cases settle out of court, which can take several months to over a year. Cases that proceed to litigation and trial can take two years or more. Your attorney can provide a more specific timeline after evaluating your situation.
